description: False-colour infrared (NIR) satellite image depicting a densely built-up urban area in Nyköping, Sweden, captured on 2011-06-03 by Spot 5 at 2.5 m resolution, using a 1/2/3 band combination. The image shows a dark blue/black river in the upper portion, flanked by bright red vegetation (healthy biomass). The urban fabric, consisting of buildings and roads, appears in shades of dark blue and grey, consistent with its spectral signature in false-colour imagery. A turquoise blue line delineates a polygonal area within the urban fabric, labelled "1110". This area corresponds to Class 1.1.1 (Continuous Urban Fabric) in the CORINE Land Cover (CLC) nomenclature. Additional yellow dashed lines delineate other land parcels, likely property boundaries or other thematic features, within both urban and vegetated areas.
